method: Pour milk to about three-fifths of the cup, leaving room for the matcha and cold foam.

drinks.name: Double Matcha
method: Weigh or measure the syrup for the cup size.
Pour milk to about three-fifths of the cup, leaving room for the matcha and matcha cold foam.
Spoon the matcha over the milk.
drinks.note: The double: matcha in the drink, matcha again in the cold foam on top.
